# Coons Roofing

> Commercial roofing contractor serving property managers and building owners
> across the Houston metro. Repair first. We recommend replacement only when the
> numbers support it, and we show the math.

Coons Roofing is a commercial-only roofing contractor based in Houston, Texas.
The company does not do residential work. Owner: Wade Coons.

## Primary specialty

Fluid-applied restoration of aging metal roofs. Houston's industrial corridors
are full of R-panel metal roofs where the panels still have life left but the
fasteners, laps and finish have failed. A fluid-applied system replaces or
tightens every fastener, primes the rust, reinforces the seams and penetrations,
then coats the field with an elastomeric topcoat to warranty thickness. It
typically runs $2.50 to $5.00 per square foot against $8 to $15 or more for
replacement, and the building stays open during the work. Coons Roofing is
certified with IPC, Karnak, Everest Systems and Western Colloid for these
systems. Coatings are not sold over rusted-through panels, soft decking or
saturated insulation.

## Service area

Houston metro. Harris, Montgomery, Galveston, Fort Bend and Brazoria counties.
Named cities served: Houston, Katy, The Woodlands, Tomball, Pearland, League
City, Sugar Land, Spring, Cypress, Pasadena, Conroe.

## Manufacturer certifications

Versico, FiberTite, Duro-Last, GAF, Western Colloid, Karnak, Everest Systems,
IPC, Elevate.

- [Roof Repair](https://coonsroofing.com/repair/): Targeted repair of membrane deterioration, failed flashings, storm damage and ponding water before they escalate.
- [Roof Maintenance](https://coonsroofing.com/maintenance/): Scheduled inspection and maintenance programs that extend a commercial roof well past its expected lifespan.
- [Coating and Restoration](https://coonsroofing.com/coatings/): Restoration systems that add 15 to 20 years and defer a capital replacement.
- [Roof Replacement](https://coonsroofing.com/replacement/): System selection, budgeting, scheduling and installation when a roof genuinely has to come off.
- [Roof Inspections](https://coonsroofing.com/inspections/): Documented inspections for acquisitions, storm damage assessment and maintenance planning.
- [Emergency Roofing](https://coonsroofing.com/emergency/): Same-day response and temporary dry-in across the Houston metro when water is coming through the ceiling.
